about: Route stop notes and what the map keeps of them: bridge/app/map-protocol.mjs dropDistanceClaims (the app) and Paste.lua P.DropDistanceClaims (Copy and Paste). The HUD shows a stop's live distance; a note's own claim of how far or how close the stop is goes stale as the player moves. recording: the note seen under '1. Hezrul Bloodmark turn-in / 175 yd · ahead', and what's left of it. keep: notes that stay exactly as written (places, landmarks, compass points, instructions). drop: [note, what's left]. mixed: an instruction and a claim in one clause, [note, what's left]: only the claim's words go, never the instruction.
